notes: Single-channel half-rack digital wireless receiver (part of the ULX-D family). Rear panel labels per Shure's official spec sheet diagram: "antenna . B", "power", Ethernet icon, "mic / line" (XLR), "inst / aux" (1/4\"), "antenna . A". Power input is an external 15V DC wall-wart supply (PS41US) via a coaxial/barrel DC jack (labeled "15V 0.4A" on the back-panel diagram) — modeled as dc-barrel. Ethernet is a single 10/100 Mbps RJ45 port used for networking/WWB6/AMX-Crestron control (not an audio-over-IP/Dante port — Dante is only present on the Dual (ULXD4D) and Quad (ULXD4Q) receivers, which also add a second RJ45 secondary port and use an internal AC power supply with IEC inlet instead). No USB port on this model. RF frequency band varies by region (G50/H50/J50/etc.) — does not affect I/O. Not rack-mountable as a full 1U (it's a half-rack unit, typically mounted in pairs with an adapter kit), so rackUnits omitted.
